title: Evaluation area and the limits of cross-region transfer of single-season wildfire models with pre-fire thermal predictors: analysis code, modelling datasets and frozen outputs
description: Analysis code, the five modelling datasets, frozen numeric outputs and manuscript sources for the study 'Evaluation area and the limits of cross-region transfer of single-season wildfire models with pre-fire thermal predictors: five large Mediterranean fires' (Manavgat 2021, Muğla 2021, Bejís 2022, North Evia 2021, Montiferru 2021). Every dataset is identified by SHA-256 and every reported number is checked against the frozen outputs by the scripts in paper/figures and paper/code. The satellite processing pipeline is a separate repository (https://github.com/emrehann17/satellite-thermal-digital-twin). The MIT licence covers the code; the modelling datasets are derived from MODIS, Landsat 8, the Copernicus DEM GLO-30 and ESA WorldCover and remain subject to the terms of these products (see README).
